prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Account Sign In to Final Step: Move the sign-in screen to the very end of onboarding right before final launch, allowing users to customize and adopt their pet before authenticating.
   config: {"sign_in": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"]}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Photo Upload Screen Layout: Redesign the custom pet photo upload screen into a clean split-column layout featuring a helpful visual mascot guide alongside photo pickers.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Bring Your Pet to Life", "body": "Upload clear photos of your pet from different angles to create your custom desktop companion.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}, {"type": "photo_picker", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}}
2: [finish, new_screen] Add Interactive Desktop Controls Cheat Sheet Screen: Add a dedicated controls cheat sheet screen before completion to explain desktop pet shortcut keys and hidden toolbar controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_controls_guide", "home_intro"]}, "new_controls_guide": {"headline": "How to Interact with Your Pet", "body": "Learn how to summon, move, and chat with your new companion right from your desktop toolbar.", "layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "image", "asset": "asset:controls_overview", "style": "plain", "action": "next"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Got It", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}
3: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Pet Personality Selector Flow: Insert a short interactive personality questionnaire screen before path selection to help guide users to suitable companion choices.
   config: {"choose_path": {"_order": ["story", "new_quiz_intro", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}, "new_quiz_intro": {"headline": "Find Your Perfect Pet Companion", "body": "Answer two quick questions so we can match you with the ideal desktop pet personality.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
4: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Custom Naming Incentive: Highlight an unlockable official owner badge and custom companion title upon completing the pet adoption certificate.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Name your companion to claim your official desktop owner badge and unlock custom pet behaviors.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Pet Owner", "style": "highlight", "action": "next"}, {"type": "name_input", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}
5: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Existing Account Pet Recovery Headline: Update the sign-in screen headline and body to explicitly mention restoring existing pets when authenticating with a previous account.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Restore Your Desktop Pets", "body": "Use your registered email to keep all your adoptable pets, saved traits, and desktop settings synchronized.", "button_label": "Continue with Account"}}
6: [home, layout] Waiting Screen Two-Column Layout with Animated Activity: Switch the waiting screen layout to a two-column design featuring an animated mascot alongside rotating tips while generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "body": "Your companion is getting ready to appear on your desktop toolbar.", "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_idle_anim", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}, {"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "calm", "action": "next"}]}}
7: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Instant Setup Helper Hint: Add a prominent contextual hint explaining that chosen pet paths can be changed or expanded anytime later in app settings.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Don't worry! You can adopt more companions or switch paths anytime in your desktop app settings.", "tip_delay_seconds": 3}}
8: [finish, notification] Home Intro Desktop Sound & Launch Notification: Enable desktop sound cue playback and ready notifications on the home intro screen prior to pet spawning.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Welcome Your Desktop Pet!", "body": "Click launch to spawn your pet directly onto your active desktop toolbar.", "components": [{"type": "sound", "style": "plain", "action": "play"}]}}
9: [adoption, hint] Pick Friend Quick Selection Guidance Hint: Add a helpful tip on the Pick Friend screen clarifying that standard pets spawn instantly while custom pets take additional setup.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"hint": "Select any standard pet for instant desktop spawn, or choose custom creation to build from photos!", "tip_delay_seconds": 5}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in within onboarding is explicitly allowed by rule 4.
Redesigning the layout of the photo upload screen while preserving its function is allowed.
Adding a new controls guide screen inside onboarding before home intro is allowed by rule 4.
Inserting a pet personality quiz screen inside onboarding is allowed by rule 4.
The adoption certificate redesign removes the required official stamp.
Updating sign-in copy to mention account restoration preserves the sign-in step's function.
Redesigning the waiting screen to a two-column layout preserves the function of showing pet generation.
Adding a contextual hint to choose_path does not violate any base rules.
Adding sound cues and launch notifications to home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding visual guidance hints to the pick_friend screen is allowed.
